verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs or workflows is a fair question for an email product, but the evidence shows no recurring-schedule capability in Gmail. Snooze is a one-off, per-email reminder. Filters and API push notifications are event-triggered, not time-based recurring schedules. Gemini's "Schedule" feature only proposes meeting times, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
